Title: Wallet Tracker Card for iPhone (2-Pack)
Body (HTML):
Two slim tracker cards that slip into your wallet and show up in the Apple Find My app on your iPhone. Ring them when they're lost nearby, get an alert when you leave them behind, and see their last known location on the map.

  • Bank-card size: 85 × 54 mm, only 2 mm thin
  • Play sound: make the card chirp from Find My
  • Left-behind alerts: get notified when your wallet stops travelling with you
  • Find My network: nearby Apple devices can anonymously help locate it
  • Lost Mode: get notified when it's found and share your number
  • No subscription: pay once, no monthly fees

Compatibility: iPhone or iPad with iOS 14.5 or later. Not compatible with Android.

In the box: 2 tracker cards, quick-start guide.
